climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: An Emilia-Romagna PDO for still, semi-sparkling and quality sparkling wine many of them from Lambrusco varieties such as Salamino, Grasparossa and Maestri.
